description: Create or idempotently ensure a server-side /loop schedule in an authorized channel (mode: okr_wake, okr_watch, or prompt). Calls POST /api/loops and verifies the resulting loop via /api/loops/mine.

channel_id.description: Target channel_id (group/project room for okr_wake/okr_watch; group or owner-agent DM for prompt)

interval.description: Cadence shorthand like 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h (1m..24h; defaults to 5m when interval_ms omitted)

mode.description: okr_wake (zero-cost DAG dependency-clear/assignee wake), okr_watch (stalled-progress watch), or prompt (periodic tick)

objective_id.description: Required when mode is okr_wake or okr_watch: active Objective ID anchored to channel_id

prompt.description: Required when mode is prompt: plain periodic tick prompt (max 500 chars; no secrets)

stall_minutes.description: okr_watch only: base silent stall threshold in minutes (integer 5..1440, default 5)

target_agents.description: Optional @target agent handles (max 12) for group loops

watch_idle.description: okr_watch only: also alert when all tasks sit idle in todo with zero doing

watch_supply.description: okr_watch only: also alert when all tasks are done (task-supply exhausted)

name: create_loop
